ios.desc:
Tired of Twitter? Message in real life using Big Words. This simple app is great for quickly grabbing attention, passing messages, and making a statement.

+ SWIPE for Multiple Pages
+ ROTATE to Landscape and Portrait
+ DOUBLE-TAP to Edit
+ SYNC to Apple Watch

Quite simply, Big Words is the easiest way to display any text or emoji on Apple Watch. 

"I've been addicted to Big Words for years. I've campaigned tirelessly for this app in SF, Berlin, Paris, London, and NY, and cannot stop using it. Someone help me. Seriously, someone help me stop." -@boltron

Find out more via @DollarApp on Twitter.
